original_title: Jet crash marks third incident at Idaho air show in 23 years - KTVB

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: A jet crash occurred at an Idaho air show, marking the third incident in 23 years. This event poses a significant risk to aviation safety and may impact future air shows and aviation events in the area.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased security measures are likely to be implemented at the air show and surrounding areas. Emergency services will be on high alert, and an investigation into the cause of the crash will be launched.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The incident may lead to a review of safety protocols and procedures at air shows and aviation events across the country. It may also impact the reputation of the air show and the aviation industry as a whole.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: The crash may cause disruptions to air show schedules and logistics. It may also lead to increased scrutiny of aviation safety and security measures, potentially impacting the operations of airlines, airports, and other aviation-related businesses.
